title: Artificial neural network predicts beta-lactam hypersensitivity, tested prospectively
summary: An ANN built on 656 retrospectively analyzed patients was evaluated prospectively in 615 patients with a definite allergy diagnosis. In the prospective sample sensitivity was 81.1%, specificity 97.9%, PPV 91.1% and NPV 95.2%, whereas the best logistic regression reached sensitivity of 31.9%. It is single-center work.
ai_technology: Artificial neural network compared with logistic regression
organization: Universidad de Salamanca; Instituto de Investigación Biomédica de Salamanca

evidence.tested: Prospective evaluation in 615 patients who underwent beta-lactam allergy evaluation in 2011-2017.
evidence.unknown: Generalization beyond one center is unknown. Abstract-based; full text not reviewed.
evidence.ai_role: An ANN predicted hypersensitivity from clinical data.
